implementation_summary: shared/context-usage.ts gains buildContextUsageNote, applyContextPlacement (collate semantics, new array, compaction mapped structurally), lastUsedTokens and placeStepsForModel (the one recipe used everywhere). ws-handler builds a per-invocation placed copy for every router.streamResponse call (always, so compaction maps), with a note only when compact_context is an enabled tool name; usedTokens starts at the last usage in incoming steps and is replaced by each response's usage. Client: chat.send now serialises contextWindow/contextWindowSource/modelFamily from the same useContextWindow resolution as the meter, which now also fetches while compact_context is active. The JSON preview, toOllamaFilteredMessages, useReconciliation and request-preview-extras apply the same recipe with the note rebuilt from the steps before the target.
decisions: Collate: note goes onto the last wire step (skipping meta/reasoning/blank system) when user-role, else a separate synthetic user step (id 'context-usage-note') at the end.
A compaction step maps to a user step; an immediately following user or compaction step is collated onto it with a blank line. Ordinary adjacent user steps are left alone.
Placements CONTEXT_PLACEMENT cannot yield are not implemented: applyContextPlacement throws for them; an optional `placement` option makes family-exception lookup testable.

Server note window: no contextWindow/source in chat.send means source 'assumed' (used tokens only). A response without usage gives a number-free note for the next invocation rather than a stale older figure.
Note wording is a parenthesised 'Automatic note from the app, not written by the user.' lead so it reads as a final paragraph of the user's message.
Client contextRequestRef supplies fields only for the selected conversation; modelFamily = selectedModel.family (the /models/show details.family value OllamaModel carries) is sent whenever known.
caveats: No over-the-wire test of a compaction step: STEP_KINDS rejects it until S6; compaction mapping is covered at unit level.
A send issued before the first window resolution completes carries no window and the note states used tokens only.

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The note's window had to be reconciled with a client that may not have resolved it yet; the brief did not say what the server should assume, so 'no window means assumed' was chosen. Also, validateChatRequest rejects the not-yet-registered compaction kind, which blocks an end-to-end test of the always-called mapping until S6.
retrospective.surprised_by: A property test over arbitrary doubles found the note printing 'Infinity%' for denormal windows; the percentage and window need explicit finiteness guards.
